methods.comment:
* Get a new IPsec SPI and maintain the reservation. * *

If this instance is constructed by a spiGenerator, this method will try to allocate SPI * once for the return value of spiGenerator#nextInt. Otherwise the SPI will be allocated by the * Kernel. * * @return an instance of SecurityParameterIndex.
